bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 Winner - 'Best Traditional Afternoon Tea'  Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea at The Beaumont Hotel, a 5-star luxury hotel in Mayfair exuding the glitz and glamour of the 1920s.  The 5-star Beaumont Hotel occupies a fine Art Deco building on a quiet garden square, close to the boutiques, galleries and museums of Mayfair, St James's and the West End.  Afternoon Tea is served in Gatsby's Room, the beating heart of the hotel and a relaxing space in which to enjoy this Great British ritual in the company of family and friends. Afternoon Tea at The Beaumont is served according to the best of English traditions, sprinkled with a light American accent.  Tuck into a delicious selection of finger sandwiches, including Coronation Smoked Chicken & Hendick's Cured Lox, followed by a decadent array of scones and pastries. Highlights include a Strawberry & Cream Choux, Cherry Bakewell Pie and Coconut & Chocolate Mounds.  All of this is served alongside your choice of loose-leaf tea and, if you're feeling extra fancy, a glass of English Sparkling Wine or a non-alcoholic JING Jasmine Pearls Sparkling Tea. A vegan Afternoon Tea is also available, featuring an array on lovingly crafted plant-based delights.  Children's Afternoon Tea is also available, priced at £30 per child.
